lines.2: The same old route to school.
lines.3: Yet somehow, the scenery around me looks more colorful.
lines.4: 「Yeah, I'm feeling good. The new semester's starting and I'm brimming with energy.」
lines.11: 「Huh? You two haven't broken up, have you?」
lines.13: 「She seems awfully detached. She's no different from first-semester Yashi.」
lines.16: 「Yashi, you haven't been hanging around the station lately.」
lines.18: 「...Are things not going well with Leo?」
lines.20: 「I-I see. Your answers are pretty cold... You haven't mellowed out at all.」
lines.22: 「Hey, what was that? She's as scary as ever. That's no good. Women ought to serve men. You need to train her properly.」
lines.23: 「I'm telling you, she's fine like that.」
lines.27: At school, Nagomi is the same as ever.
lines.28: And now, the executive committee's first meeting of the second semester.
lines.29: 「The second semester is packed with the Ryuumei Festival, the school trip, and all sorts of events. We're busy, so take this seriously.」
lines.31: The Princess is being serious for once.
lines.32: 「Now that everyone's here, the subject of today's meeting is...」
lines.33: 「The rumors that Tsushima and Nagomin are dating.」
lines.35: 「Yoppi and I spotted you two out together while we were eating chocolate crepes.」
lines.36: 「And it isn't just us. Quite a few people say they've seen you together.」
lines.38: 「So if you're going on dates that often, may we assume you're a couple?」
lines.42: 「...Well, I guess there isn't much reason to hide it.」
lines.47: 「Nagomi and I started dating around the beginning of August.」
lines.48: 「You admitted that easily. Congratulations, first of all.」
lines.57: 「Huh? Did you ever predict anything about us?」
lines.58: 「Yeah. I asked her to take a look. I was worried about you.」
lines.59: 「But I'm glad for you, Tsushima. Congratulations!」
lines.61: 「Meanwhile, the all-important Nagomin is silently updating the accounts and acting as if none of this concerns her.」
lines.62: 「...It is true that I'm dating Senpai.」
lines.63: 「But that is all. It isn't something to make a fuss over.」
lines.64: 「That's cold enough to chill a bottle of cola.」
lines.66: 「Her boobs? She's a first-year, so there's plenty of future potential.」
lines.69: 「Cute... I think I can see it, somehow...」
lines.70: 「Really? I can't understand it at all.」
lines.71: 「If it were Yoppi, 'cute' would make sense, but...」
lines.72: The Princess pats Sato on the head.
lines.73: 「But her... Cute? She's beautiful, certainly, but would you call her cute?」
lines.74: 「Please don't refer to me with a pronoun.」
lines.75: 「What are you talking about? She's incredibly cute.」
lines.77: 「Leo's pretty cute when he insists like that too.」
lines.79: 「No. And why are you blushing, Princess?」
lines.80: 「What did he say to win you over, Nagomin?」
lines.81: 「There is no reason for me to tell you.」
lines.82: 「More importantly, I would like to get some work done.」
lines.83: 「My, my. Your attitude hasn't changed since the first semester.」
lines.84: 「Ahaha. You seem kind of cold, Yashi.」
lines.87: 「I think the Princess and the rest of you are making far too much noise.」
lines.88: 「Trying to tease me for your amusement is pointless. Right now, you all look like children to me.」
lines.90: 「I don't rise to childish taunts. I'm always perfectly calm.」
lines.93: Everyone tenses, expecting the Princess to get angry.
lines.94: But for some reason, the Princess smiles the entire time.
lines.96: A manga-style anger mark--one of those # things--stood out clearly on her forehead!
